name: lua
description: Lua 5.4 for the SwirlOS terminal: scripts, os.execute, a swirl library and an interactive prompt.
author: Swirl
title: Lua
tagline: Run Lua scripts from the terminal.
long:
Lua 5.4.9, the small fast scripting language.
Type: lua -run /home/user/hello.lua
Or straight from the prompt: lua -e print(1+1)
Run other programs with os.execute / io.popen, and use the swirl library to list folders, sleep, spawn and read system info. Interactive mode needs the terminal input patch. Docs: cat /system/doc/lua.txt
